texts: bad: beside the group-level drawing the parse adds a per-lantern rule that hands every single lantern the whole swarm — it asserts each lantern drew all the many nightmoths, while your sentence gives a total across them. Mark the lanterns as acting as one so nothing distributes: "On day 85 of Year 1, the lanterns at the Hollows together drew many nightmoths." Separately, "day 85 of Year 1" lands in the day-of-month slot, so it records the 85th of a month; if your calendar has month names, date the episode as a month plus a day within it.

bad: the same over-reach — the per-lantern rule makes each Cliff Path lantern draw the entire handful, which the sentence does not say, since the handful is the total across the lanterns. Same minimal fix: "The lanterns of the Cliff Path together drew a handful of nightmoths that autumn." ("that autumn" itself resolved correctly and carried Year 1 forward.)

mixed: both events, both counts, the place, the season and the "so" link all land, but the parse stops at the group level and never hands the hunting or the fleeing down to individual sky-cats or nightmoths, so nothing would follow about a named one later. Your wording is not the cause, and the only phrasing that would force the per-member step ("each of the sky-cats hunted") would throw the count away — so leave this sentence as written; the omission is ours to fix.
good. the writing, the note as the thing it produced, the note's aboutness and the Council as the party it was written for all land.

mixed: the harvest, its place and the rise all land, but "that week" becomes a bare label with nothing attached — unlike "that autumn" earlier it does not pick up Year 1, so the rise floats free of the dated episode. Anchor it in the words: "The thread harvest at the Hollows rose in that week of Year 1."

mixed: "stayed thin" comes through fully — the thin state, its continuation and the past tense — and "on the Cliff Path" keeps its surface preposition, but "that week" again carries no year, so this clause is not tied to the dated episode either. Same fix: "The thread harvest on the Cliff Path stayed thin in that week of Year 1."
